records.title: Time-uniform, nonparametric, nonasymptotic confidence sequences
records.applicability: Supports optional-stopping-valid confidence sequences; does not itself optimize expected sample count.

records.title: Inspection for Circuit Board Assembly
records.applicability: Supports joint inspection/test/failure-cost modeling in electronics; lacks the full return-disassembly-reassembly loop.

records.title: An Evolutionary Algorithm and Discrete Event Simulation for Optimizing Inspection Strategies for Multi-stage Processes
records.applicability: Supports DES plus EA for larger multistage inspection systems; unnecessary for the 65536-policy contest instance.

records.title: A Sampling-Based Inspection and Cost Optimization Model for Electronic Assembly Quality Control
records.applicability: Near-isomorphic benchmark, but repeated rework, inventory return, correlated defects and inspection errors are outside its baseline scope.

claims.statement: Time-uniform confidence sequences preserve coverage under optional stopping.
Electronics inspection design can jointly account for testing, repair and defective units shipped to customers.
DES plus evolutionary search is an established candidate for multistage inspection-location/type/limit optimization.
The near-isomorphic 2026 framework omits repeated rework cycles and full inventory-return state.
